explanation: Sort closed intervals by their right endpoints. When the most recent chosen point does not cover the next interval, choose that interval’s right endpoint; this also reaches as far right as possible for later intervals.
attribution: Original C# implementation written for EPI Practice from the displayed contract; no upstream reference code copied.
correctness: For the unhit interval with earliest right endpoint, every feasible cover must choose some point inside it. Moving that point to its right endpoint cannot uncover any later-ending interval it previously hit. Thus selecting that endpoint is safe, and repeating on remaining unhit intervals yields a minimum cover.
walkthrough: For closed intervals [1,2], [2,5] and [6,9], choose point 2 for the first interval; it also hits the second at its endpoint. Point 9 hits the third, giving 2 visits.
edgeCases: Nested intervals may all share one chosen point.
